meta.title: Signal catalog — what we originate, how we test, and what the data says
meta.policy: Every signal row states its inputs (pre-kickoff only), its hypothesis, its measured result on the committed extract, and the gate outcome. Signals with unverified inputs or prices are described; their profit cells stay blank.

origination_summary.model: home=mu+off_home-def_away+hfa; away=mu+off_away-def_home; weighted least squares with ridge lambda 4.0 half-life 180 days; HFA shrunk toward 10-season mean with 60 pseudo-obs; hyperparameters chosen on 2021-2022 (validation MAE 10.354), frozen for 2023+ test.
origination_summary.accuracy: spread MAE 10.39 pts (model) vs 10.25 pts (closing) walk-forward 2023-2026; incremental regression c=-0.019 (p=0.881) — no incremental information.
origination_summary.source_notes: Model spec from data/derived/model.json; market accuracy from data/derived/market.json; sign convention proven via diag_signs.json (corr 0.425, moneyline cross-check means +5.67 home fav vs -4.66 dog).

rows.signal: Rest advantage (extra rest days vs opponent)
rows.inputs: away_rest, home_rest from schedules feed (days of rest, confirmed in nflreadr dictionary)
rows.hypothesis: Team with +3 or more days rest has a margin edge beyond the line
rows.measured: n=204 settled bets in published window; ROI +0.09% (p large). Underpowered vs required n≈6809.

rows.inputs: rest flag derived from away_rest/home_rest ≥14-day gap
rows.hypothesis: Bye-week team benefits from rest and preparation

rows.inputs: spread_line sign + division grouping (inferred from standings, not hard-coded)
rows.hypothesis: Division familiarity narrows spread for home dogs
rows.measured: n=137 decided (of 204 total); ROI -1.21%; best gated count 5/10 — still rejected.

rows.signal: Model spread edge ≥2 pts vs closing
rows.hypothesis: When model disagrees with close by 2+ pts, fading close has value
rows.measured: n=572 bets; decided 557; ROI -5.28%; p=0.87; fails G2,G4,G5,G6,G8,G9.

rows.signal: Model spread edge ≥3 pts vs closing
rows.hypothesis: Larger disagreement more likely to survive market info
rows.measured: n=409; decided 396; ROI around -3% (varies by build). Fails multiple gates.

rows.inputs: Weather wind_gust with weather_available boolean (planned SUG-06); historically ~57% outdoor coverage
rows.hypothesis: Wind suppresses scoring more than closing total implies
rows.measured: 46 bets in 2023+ window; ROI +1.51% (not significant). Earlier 649-bet figure included 219 no-price rows at assumed -110; corrected to 430 bets ROI +7.14% p=0.125, 2/6 gates, decays in holdout.

rows.signal: QB passing yards → WR1 receiving yards (same-team prop combo)
rows.inputs: Per-team-game QB attempts≥10 → most-targeted WR/TE/RB as WR1
rows.hypothesis: Strong positive coupling means independent leg pricing understates joint probability
rows.measured: r=0.562 (n=7560, 95% CI via Fisher z). Joint exceedance 11.1% vs product 5.7% — independence error factor 1.95.

rows.inputs: Points for/against per team-season → expected wins exponent 2.37
rows.hypothesis: Luck wins mean-revert; fading teams with high luck improves forward prediction
rows.measured: R²=0.819 expected vs actual win% over 877 team-seasons; SD luck=1.32 wins; y-o-y luck r=0.024 p=0.49 (842 pairs) — luck is transient.

rows.inputs: Ten-season prior mean + current season margin signal
rows.hypothesis: Home edge stable around ~2 pts; short-sample shrinkage avoids overfitting a 2026 anomaly
rows.measured: Model HFA shrunk toward 10-season mean with 60 pseudo-observations; 2026 home teams have negative mean margin (-0.43) so unshrunk HFA collapsed to 0.2 pts.
Year-over-year r=0.082 (p small but BH-flagged marginal) — not used in any strategy.

rows.inputs: injury_report_daily + depth_chart_tier → per-team per-week deficiency score (proposed schema above)
rows.hypothesis: Teams fielding 2nd/3rd/4th string starters lose more margin than line implies
rows.status: unmeasured — design only; blank per verification policy

rows.inputs: Player-week stats with rolling season-mean and last-3 baselines
rows.hypothesis: Forecast at season-mean has predictive correlation beyond baseline
rows.measured: n=8884; MAE forecast 19.96 vs baseline 19.89 (improvement -0.35%); corr 0.580; originated line over rate 52.35% — essentially unbiased but not profitable without prices.
